facts.fact: PM Vishwakarma registration needs Aadhaar, mobile number, bank details and ration card (all mandatory)
facts.quote: Required documents or information: Aadhaar, Mobile number, Bank details, Ration card mandatory for the registration.

facts.fact: A beneficiary without a ration card must produce the Aadhaar cards of all family members
facts.quote: In case of a beneficiary not having a ration card, they would be required to produce Aadhaar cards of all family members.

facts.fact: A beneficiary without a bank account must first open one, with hand-holding by the CSC
facts.quote: If beneficiary does not have bank account, they will be first required to open a bank account for which hand holding shall be done by the CSC.

behaviour: Lists the documents exactly as in the myScheme PM Vishwakarma record (myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pmv), citing it; if a field is not published it says so rather than inventing documents.
fail_if: It adds documents not in the record (e.g. income or caste certificate) as required, omits the ration card requirement, or cites a non-official site.
summary: Added the documents from the myScheme PM Vishwakarma record (slug 'pmv'): Aadhaar, mobile, bank details, ration card; family Aadhaar if no ration card; bank account opened via CSC if none.
